key.name: enter-shortcut
key.description: Accelerators that move from a personal workspace up to the AgentWorkspaces desktop, which is stacked above your personal ones.

key.name: return-shortcut
key.summary: Come back down to your personal workspace
key.description: Accelerators that move from the AgentWorkspaces desktop back down to the personal workspace you came from.

key.name: create-on-demand
key.summary: Create the AgentWorkspaces workspace on demand
key.description: When entering and no AgentWorkspaces viewer window exists, create a dedicated GNOME workspace and ask the AgentWorkspaces service to open the viewer there. When off, entering only works while a viewer window already exists.

key.name: environment-mode
key.summary: Open the viewer as a full-screen environment
key.description: On: the viewer opens full screen without window chrome; its controls appear when the mouse moves. Off: it opens as an ordinary maximized window with a title bar and the workspace list.

key.name: daemon-command
key.description: Used when the systemd user unit cannot start the AgentWorkspaces service. Empty: look for agent-workspaces in the usual install locations and in PATH.

key.name: backup
key.summary: Bindings removed from GNOME while the extension is enabled (JSON)
key.description: Written before the extension removes an accelerator from org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings, cleared after it is restored. A non-empty value at start-up means the shell ended while the bindings were removed, and they are restored first.

key.name: conflicts
key.summary: Other bindings that use the same accelerators
key.description: Filled by the extension; read by the preferences page.

key.name: test-hooks
key.description: Used by the isolated-session tests. Leave off.
